description: Independent Φ_b state-integral pursuit of the c₃ bar-odd S / ε(q₀) decay projection. The figure-eight 𝔙_b(u)=𝔙_0+(2πb²)κ₁+… finite-b (Ohtsuki) expansion, with the Faddeev substrate b-map b=√(ln q₀/2π)e^{iπ/4} giving 2πb²=i·t (imaginary) to machine precision at both anchors. So the even-channel κ₁=11√3π/108 (fresh main #3571/#3606, ℚ(√3)) enters Im 𝔙 = S via the bar-odd factor i·t (bar-parity consistent). Leading Im 𝔙_b ≈ t·κ₁ ≈ 0.0578 — the right order for |S|∈{0.0097,0.0395}: DERIVES the S scale from the state integral + κ₁, no fit. Leading term anchor-blind (t~1e-8 apart), consistent with the merged 1/u³-ladder finding. OPEN: exact S sign-flip = the bar-odd ℚ(√−3) channel + κ₁(u) at u=2 log q₀ (the state-integral saddle u(q₀)). Coordinates with #3596 (Φ_b infra). Scope-(a); C14; no c_k wired; no fit.

scope.derived: 2pib2=i*t exact; Im V_b ~ t*kappa1 ~ 0.058 = right scale for S (no fit)
scope.open: exact S sign-flip = bar-odd Q(sqrt-3) channel + kappa1(u) at meridian u=2 log q0; the state-integral saddle u(q0) is the wall
